isolatedDecision.finding: The strongest frame meaningfully corrects the historical weapon and costume silhouette, but remains a carefully staged wide greatsword hold. Blade mass does not visibly drive one continuous arrest through the spine, scapulae, shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, feet, cloth, plates, and conductor.

visualReview.benchmarkPolicy: Aggregate blinded-comparison results only; no benchmark image, crop, comparison sheet, filename, path, or other benchmark pixel is published.
visualReview.singleBiggestGap: A genuinely arrested, mechanically unified force chain: the current image still reads as a wide posed greatsword hold because blade momentum does not visibly load the spine, scapulae, shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, feet, cloth, plates, and conductor as one violent deceleration event.

decision.instruction: Preserve the corrected non-historical silhouette and solved contact, but do not begin paid 3D generation or Unity integration from this pack.

limitations: The filed image is original 2D concept art, not gameplay or game capture.

Strongest bounded output, but the fresh critic rejected its staged hold and incomplete force chain.

nextRound.target: Freeze the accepted identity, equipment, storm-shear, and solved contact; use an original joint-and-weapon pose guide to produce one violent deceleration keyframe in which blade momentum visibly deforms the entire grip-to-ground body and equipment chain.
